author_inventory_contract.stable_scan: Perform two complete bounded reads under the author lock. author_inventory_contract.overflow: Count, per-file, aggregate-byte, filename-byte, arithmetic-overflow, or second-scan mismatch refuses before timestamp allocation or filesystem mutation and preserves every entry.
